gen.title: Sort expected counts for homozygous and heterozygous genotypes

items.label: The parameter k
items.quote: The parameter k also represents the expected number of homozygous genotypes

items.label: expected number of homozygous genotypes
items.quote: The parameter k also represents the expected number of homozygous genotypes, and k[(k-1)/2] represents the expected number of heterozygous genotypes.

items.label: k is the number of alleles at a particular locus
items.quote: k(k+1)/2, where k is the number of alleles at a particular locus

items.label: k(k+1)/2
items.quote: can be calculated using the formula k(k+1)/2, where k is the number of alleles at a particular locus

items.label: k[(k-1)/2]
items.quote: k[(k-1)/2] represents the expected number of heterozygous genotypes

items.label: expected number of heterozygous genotypes
items.quote: and k[(k-1)/2] represents the expected number of heterozygous genotypes

items.label: observed heterozygosity
items.quote: The observed heterozygosity can be compared to the expected heterozygosity

checks.message: every sort text length, id pattern and id uniqueness is within the frozen limits
all 7 item quote(s) appear verbatim in their cited source after whitespace normalisation (quotes-verbatim)

every item label occurs in its quote and every group label occurs in the quote or the same source paragraph (item-and-group-in-quote; the design discloses the weak-link false accept on long paragraphs — every quote is shown to the teacher)
every declared group is referenced by >= 2 items and every item groupId resolves (groups-covered)
every item has a distinct label after normalisation (distinct-items)
groups 2 (2-4) and items 7 (6-12) are within the frozen counts (counts-valid)
every number in group and item labels appears on the cited page or in the same quote (N-01) (numbers-checkable)
